tools_helpful.evidence: Turn 1-14: bootstrap scaffolded the WinUI project, seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md (8 rows) + MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md, and injected the workflow the agent followed to a first-try clean build (Turn 30: 'Build succeeded in 18.5s').
Turns 31/33: caught the one real workflow omission (mapping rows left at Status=copied) and, after the agent flipped them to done, reported 'Validate-UwpMigration: PASS' including a smoke launch.

tools_problematic.problem: Emits a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' on a fully-correct migration that defers nothing.
tools_problematic.evidence: Turn 31 and Turn 33 validator output both show the WARN even after the run reaches 'Validate-UwpMigration: PASS'. The DEFERRED file only contains the seeded '| (none) | — |' placeholder.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its 'no defer rows' branch recognizes only the literal sentinel phrase 'No items deferred', which neither Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 nor the skill ever writes (the seed uses a '| (none) | — |' placeholder row). The PASS path is therefore dead and the WARN path always fires when nothing is deferred.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Detect the no-defer state structurally: PASS when the DEFERRED table has no real data rows (ignoring header/separator and the seeded '(none)' placeholder).

doc_errors.wrong: Checks `if ($deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred')` to decide the no-defer PASS.
doc_errors.correct: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 seeds `| (none) | — |` (line ~480), never the phrase 'No items deferred'. The validator must key off the seeded placeholder / absence of real rows.

special_apis.special_handling: Works unchanged in a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app; the WinUI template is MSIX-packaged with identity, so Package.Current returns the WinUI package's own identity/dependencies (a legitimate superset/different framework deps vs the UWP original — not a regression).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent migrated the files but had not flipped the MIGRATION-MAPPING.md Status column from 'copied' to 'done'.
errors_encountered.fix: Turn 32: bulk-edited the 8 rows copied→done; re-run passed (Turn 33).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: One [FAIL] (rows at Status=copied) plus a persistent [WARN] about MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md consistency.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The [FAIL] was a real workflow step the agent missed; the [WARN] is a false positive baked into the validator (seed/validator sentinel mismatch) that no agent action can clear.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent flipped Status to done; the [WARN] remained but the gate still reached PASS.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Fix Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 so the no-defer case reports PASS instead of a misleading WARN, so agents are not sent chasing a non-existent consistency problem.

env_issues.issue: UWP golden captured in dark theme; migrated WinUI 3 rendered light theme (cosmetic only, per score notes).
env_issues.workaround: None needed — the UWP source set no RequestedTheme, so the difference is a capture-environment system default, not a migration defect. Forcing a theme would be wrong when the source didn't request one.
